 PlayStation's Black Friday sale starts Nov. 16 with $100 off PS VR2, $20 off DualSense controllers and discounts on Pulse audio, PS5 games and more.
 Kasey Caminiti USA TODAY Nov. 16, 2026, 12:00 a.m. ET Hear this story PlayStation's Black Friday sale starts Nov. 16 , with some of the biggest savings landing on PS5 accessories and PlayStation VR2. Shoppers can save $100 on PS VR2 , $40 on the Pulse Elite Wireless Headset and $20 on DualSense Wireless Controllers in the U.S.
 The sale also includes select PS5 games, Collector's Editions, gaming storage and other officially licensed accessories. Deals vary by country and product, and some products may sell out before the promotion ends.
 PlayStation Black Friday deals at a glance
 Here are some of the standout U.S. discounts:
 PlayStation VR2 : $100 off
 DualSense Wireless Controller : $20 off
 DualSense Edge Wireless Controller : $30 off
 Pulse Elite Wireless Headset : $40 off
 Pulse Explore Wireless Earbuds : $30 off
 PS VR2 Sense Controller Charging Station : $30 off
 "Ghost of Yōtei" Collector's Edition : $100 off
 "Marvel's Wolverine" PS5 game disc : $20 off
 27-inch Gaming Monitor with DualSense Charging Hook : $50 off

Save $40 at PlayStation More: Sony’s new oil-slick GTA VI controller might be its best design yet More PlayStation accessories are discounted
 The Access Controller is $30 off in the U.S. and U.S. shoppers can also save $50 on the 27-inch Gaming Monitor with DualSense Charging Hook , while select SanDisk Optimus SSD Modules are discounted by as much as $100.
 PS5 Slim Console Covers are $15 off and covers made for the original PS5 are $25 off in the U.S.
 Additional officially licensed third-party accessories are included, although discounts vary by product.
 Shop all PlayStation deals Are PS5 consoles on sale for Black Friday?
 No PS5 console Black Friday discount has been confirmed as part of this promotion yet.
 PlayStation is discounting console covers, controllers and other PS5 accessories, but shoppers shouldn't assume that a PS5 console appearing in the PlayStation store is receiving a promotional Black Friday price.
 When do PlayStation Black Friday deals end?
 PlayStation's Black Friday sale begins at midnight local time Nov. 16, but individual deals can have different promotional periods.
 The final day of the sale is Dec. 31 in the U.S.
 Availability varies by region, and deals may sell out. Check the individual product page for the current price and promotional period before buying.
